VID-0300.title: Die Cars collector profile and achievement badges
VID-0300.description: A light mobile collector interface. The poster shows an Onboarded achievement detail with a Share button. Inspected clip frames show a collector profile with recent model cars and an Achievements screen, including a large Diecast Con Barcelona 2026 badge and a grid of locked and unlocked awards. This is evidence for collection profiles and gamification, not a bookshelf UI. Exact transition timing was not measured.

review.scope: poster, clip opening, and frame at 10 seconds
review.note: Corrects a confirmed mismatch: previous bookshelf description did not match the actual poster or inspected clip frames.

VID-0304.title: Loading, list prefetch and skeleton-state demonstrations
VID-0304.description: A sequence of light web interaction demonstrations. The poster shows a Today task list labelled Server rendered. Four sampled clip frames include a Mail skeleton layout, a branching data diagram, side-by-side Fetch on click and Prefetch on hover grocery lists, and a skeleton card with a speed slider. Useful for comparing loading and prefetch feedback; the clip contains several separate demonstrations.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Targeted visual review; not a complete playback or source attribution review.

VID-0305.title: Spending dashboard and New Expense sheet
VID-0305.description: A dark mobile finance flow with yellow accents. Sampled frames show a balance home, a Spending view with a horizontal row of brightly coloured category cylinders, and a New Expense sheet. The sheet includes an amount, category, date, payment-method tiles and a yellow Save button; another sampled state contains Pharmacy Purchase and $21.00. The poster is the spending overview, not the form.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Targeted visual review; not a complete playback or source attribution review.

VID-0306.title: Pastel dot-grid interaction with Japanese text
VID-0306.description: A close crop of the lower portion of a phone mockup. Japanese text sits above a rounded, translucent dot-grid panel. Across sampled frames, small coloured discs and a glowing marker occupy different grid positions while the surrounding tint shifts from cool grey to warm yellow and green. This is an interaction study, not simply a static pink card. The full product context is not visible.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Targeted visual review; not a complete playback or source attribution review.

VID-0309.title: Dashr delivery onboarding and scooter carousel
VID-0309.description: Two light mobile screens for Dashr on a pale background. One is a lime-green splash with the word Dashr. The other combines scooter imagery, the headline Deliver faster, earn smarter with Dashr, a lime Get on the Road button and a sign-in link. Sampled clip frames show the scooter imagery changing across the hero.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Corrects a confirmed mismatch: this is Dashr onboarding, not the GOMPASHE dark item list in VID-0312.

VID-0313.title: In-hand pink receipt deformation interaction
VID-0313.description: A phone filmed in a hand, showing a dark Russian-language interface with a pink receipt-like card. Across sampled frames, a finger touches the card and its paper silhouette folds, stretches and changes shape. Telegram and VK sharing controls appear along the bottom. This is a direct-manipulation paper interaction; the samples do not establish OCR or a plant-identification workflow.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Corrects a confirmed mismatch: the visible object is a receipt-like pink card, not a flower capture interface.

VID-0323.title: mymind save-from-Photos flow
VID-0323.description: An iPhone save flow on a warm orange-red background. Sampled frames show a quote image open in Photos, the iOS share sheet, and a translucent confirmation screen reading Good find! It’s in your mind, with an Add Tags/Notes control. The mymind.com label appears below the device. This is a capture/save handoff, not a lock-screen wallpaper editor.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Corrects a confirmed mismatch: previous lock-screen-editor copy belongs to a different type of promo.

VID-0329.title: muso song creation and gift-opening promo
VID-0329.description: A light promotional sequence for muso. Sampled frames show a phone headed Create your song, a Make it yours section with Create My Song, and a black record-sleeve card with the muso name. Another frame reads You received a gift! with a Play your gift button. This is a music creation and gifting flow, not an in-hand receipt scanner.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Corrects a confirmed mismatch: receipt-scanning metadata did not describe this media.

VID-0330.title: Lock-screen card editor promotional sequence
VID-0330.description: A lock-screen card customisation promo on dark coloured backgrounds. Sampled frames show a pink lock screen, a card template selector, drawing and colour controls, reshaping of the small card and a Save it instruction. Headlines include Pick one of 29 designs and Draw right on it. The sampled sequence is about authored lock-screen cards, not a mosaic of photographs.

review.scope: poster and clip frames at 5%, 30%, 60%, 90%
review.note: Corrects a confirmed mismatch: previous photo-mosaic description did not match the inspected frames.
